# Deepen Yadav

> Executive Engineer, Ajmer Development Authority (Ajmer, Rajasthan, India).

Deepen is a civil engineer in the Rajasthan State Government, having joined the Local Self Government
Department in 2017. After a first posting of a few months in a municipality, Deepen spent two years at
the department headquarters in Jaipur, monitoring the department's schemes and projects across the
state. Since 2019 Deepen has been at the Ajmer Development Authority, taking charge of its
time-barred projects. These include the 3.5 MLD and 40 MLD sewage treatment plants (both now
completed) and two housing projects (one completed and occupied, the other expected to be
completed by March 2027).

Education: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering & Management (IIT Delhi); B.E. (Hons.) in Civil
Engineering (BITS Pilani).
